retired_note: The 4x6 nuLOOM Deepika rug did not suit a child's room or match the existing ~5 ft round rug. No Target product verified on 2026-10-06 met every requirement (round, about 5 ft, low pile, machine washable, non-slip backing, warm neutral): HEBE beige round is 6 ft only; nuLOOM Jeni 5 ft round is 0.85 in. medium pile; Safavieh Easy Care ECR229 5 ft round has medium pile and no backing; Nourison Astra 5'3" round has no backing; Nourison New Concept Washables 5'3" round is non-slip but only navy, olive, grey, or brick. The line and its link were removed and the existing round rug stays.
